key_insight: DInf-Grid introduces a differentiable feature-grid representation that lets neural differential-equation solvers compute accurate derivatives directly from a grid, combining the speed of grid-based methods with the derivative fidelity of coordinate-based MLPs.
problem_solved: Neural DE solvers that use coordinate-based MLPs (e.g., sinusoidal networks) are slow and compute-intensive, while existing grid-based alternatives train fast but cannot reliably produce higher-order derivatives needed for accurate DE solutions; DInf-Grid addresses this trade-off.
method: Represent solution fields on a learnable multi-resolution feature grid that is fully differentiable with respect to coordinates and features.
Use differentiable interpolation and analytic/automatic differentiation on the grid features so the solver can evaluate accurate spatial/temporal derivatives required by differential equations.
Integrate the differentiable grid into neural DE training loops to speed up training and inference while preserving or improving solution accuracy.
impact: Enables faster, more scalable neural DE solvers that retain accurate derivative computation—reducing training time and compute cost for practitioners solving PDEs/ODEs with neural methods and enabling wider practical adoption.
visual_elements: Side-by-side schematic: coordinate-based MLP vs DInf-Grid (showing compute/latency and derivative paths).

paper_title: DInf-Grid: A Neural Differential Equation Solver with Differentiable Feature Grids
paper_authors: Navami Kairanda, Shanthika Naik, Marc Habermann, Avinash Sharma, Christian Theobalt
